@deskPayOnEpicbox.description: Payment steps: sub-line under the current step 'Recipient signed' of a send over Epicbox: the payment waits on the Epicbox server for the recipient's wallet. The server's host is in the tooltip. Short.

@deskPayConfirmingComma.description: Deeper payment steps: confirmations so far of the number the wallet waits for.

@deskPayOnItsWayTo.description: Overview's card for a payment you sent that is not done yet (Shallow and Deeper); name is the contact.

@deskPaySendingInPerson.description: Overview's card for a payment you sent in person (a code or a file handed over) that is not done yet (Deep end).

@deskPayArrivingFrom.description: Overview's card for a payment received that is not done yet; name is the sender.

@deskPaySendingVia.description: Overview's card (Deep end) for a payment you sent that is not done yet, when no contact or address is known; via is how it travels, e.g. 'via file'.

@deskPayArrivingVia.description: Overview's card (Deep end) for a payment received that is not done yet, when no sender is known; via is how it travels, e.g. 'via file' or 'in person'.

@deskPayStartedAt.description: Overview's card for a payment in progress: its amount and the time it started.

@deskPayTileConfirming.description: Deeper Overview tile: coins that arrived and wait for more confirmations.

@deskPayTileMining.description: Deeper Overview tile: mining rewards that are not yet spendable.

@deskPayTileAwaiting.description: Deeper Overview tile and the small Overview picture at Deeper: payments waiting for the other wallet's reply. Short: fits one line in a narrow tile.

@deskPayTileLocked.description: Deeper Overview tile: coins held by payments you sent.

deskPayMaturing: Fresh from mining, not spendable yet

@deskPayMaturing.description: Deeper row status of a mining reward that is not spendable yet.
